connect-protocol-version.title: Connect-Protocol-Version
connect-protocol-version.description: Define the version of the Connect protocol

code.description: The status code, which should be an enum value of [google.rpc.Code][google.rpc.Code].

message.description: A developer-facing error message, which should be in English. Any user-facing error message should be localized and sent in the [google.rpc.Status.details][google.rpc.Status.details] field, or localized by the client.

details.description: A list of messages that carry the error details. There is no limit on the number of messages.

type.description: A URL that acts as a globally unique identifier for the type of the serialized message. For example: `type.googleapis.com/google.rpc.ErrorInfo`. This is used to determine the schema of the data in the `value` field and is the discriminator for the `debug` field.

value.description: The Protobuf message, serialized as bytes and base64-encoded. The specific message type is identified by the `type` field.

debug.title: Debug
debug.description: Deserialized error detail payload. The 'type' field indicates the schema. This field is for easier debugging and should not be relied upon for application logic.

connect.error_details.Any.description: Contains an arbitrary serialized message along with a @type that describes the type of the serialized message, with an additional debug field for ConnectRPC error details.

correlationId.title: correlation_id
correlationId.description: Correlation identifier for tracing; should be unique per published event.

icehive.control.v1.RequestDrain.description: RequestDrain asks consumers to finish in-flight work and stop accepting new tasks.

id.title: id
id.description: Opaque monotonic id within this Controller process (resets on restart).

icehive.v1.ActivityEvent.title: ActivityEvent
icehive.v1.ActivityEvent.description: ActivityEvent is one recent control-plane observation recorded by the Controller process.

icehive.v1.CollectionRequest.title: CollectionRequest
icehive.v1.CollectionRequest.description: CollectionRequest is the JSON (protojson) body published to AMQP for on-demand collection.

cronLine.title: cron_line
cronLine.description:
Standard 5-field cron (minute hour day-of-month month day-of-week), e.g. "0 0 * * *" daily at midnight.
 When empty, the source has no schedule and is only collected when EnqueueCollectionRequest (Run now) is used.

secondsSinceLastSuccess.title: seconds_since_last_success
secondsSinceLastSuccess.description: Pipeline health (computed by controller when listing sources).

entityFreshnessAgeSeconds.title: entity_freshness_age_seconds
entityFreshnessAgeSeconds.description: Seconds since the newest entity row update for this collector type; 0 when unknown.

bodyJson.title: body_json
bodyJson.description: Full SourceSchema JSON document (kind, primary_patterns, modifiers, etc.).

value.title: value
value.description: Value as string; secrets may be redacted.

collectionSourceId.title: collection_source_id
collectionSourceId.description: Load the source from the controller DB and publish it.

ephemeralCollection.title: ephemeral_collection
ephemeralCollection.description: Inline source: published as CollectionRequest.source with id cleared; not persisted.

version.title: version
version.description: Application version (semver or dev snapshot) from the controller binary.

limit.title: limit
limit.description: Max events to return (newest first). Defaults to 50; capped at 100.

collectorType.title: collector_type
collectorType.description: When empty, returns all stored schemas. Otherwise filters by collector_type.

icehive.v1.MySQLSettings.title: MySQLSettings
icehive.v1.MySQLSettings.description: MySQLSettings describes how workers should connect to a MySQL database.

version.title: version
